recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes the missing active-source wording from FHIR-48987 without reversing later terminology decisions; any concern about the later classifier example terminology should be handled under its own tracker context.
issue_request: Applied/Persuasive CDS issue FHIR-48987 asked for a broad Evidence resource R6 checklist update, including new recorder metadata, cardinality and summary flag changes, wording updates for many Evidence elements, FiveWs author mapping, non-experimental relevant terminology, and example review; the WG approved the author proposal 18-0-0 with editorial discretion.
initial_application: PR #3290/#3295 applied most of the issue through c5246794cd29ea71df45fb98510fd24fede526db, 6ee6e9811a9dc485791222266f3738f3104cacaa, and 42cec6f6e87ace92ef8ad7af314076a5dc688307. Those commits added Evidence.recorder, changed cardinalities, updated narrative/FiveWs mapping, and handled most requested wording, but several short/definition requests remained short-only and Evidence.statistic.modelCharacteristic.intended still lacked the requested definition and meaningWhenMissing.
additional_context: Evidence is active in source/fhir.ini. Later terminology decisions, including FHIR-53156 and FHIR-53699, explain the current Example/THO binding state and are already represented on the combined branch, so this reconciliation did not re-expand the seed's broad experimental-flag item. A later FHIR-57262/FHIR-57263 classification change introduced new classifier example terminology after this seed and was left for issue-specific review if needed.

source_changes: source/evidence/structuredefinition-Evidence.xml: added 11 missing ElementDefinition.definition values and Evidence.statistic.modelCharacteristic.intended meaningWhenMissing.
